maximum_scenario: Maintained preindustrial crop system with additional clearing and low-lift surface irrigation; current crop/rotation held fixed. No modern fertilizer, powered pumping or unlimited basin supply.
normalization: Multiplier equals support-weighted local reference food density, with positive floor 0.01 people/effective ha. All support totals are preserved by inverse conversion.
assumption_status: First-iteration shared land-access and water-demand priors, not measured medieval fractions. PNV controls vegetation barriers; existing cultivation is retained as dated evidence. Refine without using population as predictor.
noncrop_rule: Existing FORGE terrestrial baseline on all land, with pastoral food-system estimates where assigned. Clearing displaces existing support. Aquatic food excluded and explicitly labelled.

zero_support_completion.status: Explicit low-confidence same-livelihood/ecoregion/climate analogue for wholly unsupported ownable locations. Uses existing terrestrial support, not fish or population. Lower donor decile excluded as near-zero interpolation tails; replacement is lower quartile of eight environmental neighbours.
